rows.q: Why does redirect return 303 instead of 302?
rows.headline: ``redirect`` returns a ``303`` status code by default instead of ``302`` — decided 2026-10-07 in the 3.2.0 release notes by David Lord.

top.text: 3.2.0: ``redirect`` returns a ``303`` status code by default instead of ``302``. This tells the client to always switch to ``GET``, rather than only switching ``POST`` to ``GET``. Support loading configuration from text files — decided 2019-10-18 in #3398 by pgjones, David Lord.

rows.q: Why is the URL matched after the session is loaded?
rows.headline: Revert a change to the order that URL matching was done — decided 2021-05-21 in the 2.0.1 release notes by Pedro Torcatt.

top.text: 2.0.1: Revert a change to the order that URL matching was done. The URL is again matched after the session is loaded, so the session is available in custom URL converters. :issue:`4053`
